PACKET T0:
TASK: Add --target to ops-verdict.sh
TEXT: Parse a --target <name> flag in ops-verdict.sh and thread it into the row key the cap detector reads, keeping the 4-cell row shape.
SCENE: scripts/ops-verdict.sh writes 4-cell rows; scripts/lib/caps.sh keys on (id, criterion).
INPUTS: scripts/ops-verdict.sh, scripts/lib/caps.sh, tests/test-scripts.sh
FORBIDDEN: scripts/validate_plugin.py
DONE: bash tests/test-scripts.sh → the '--target keys the cap' case passes and the summary prints 0 failed; red on the pre-change script
REACH: ops-init.sh installs ops-verdict.sh into .operator/bin/; grep -n ops-verdict scripts/ops-install-set.sh

PACKET T1:
TASK: Strip the trailing CR run in ops-reverify.sh
TEXT: ops-reverify.sh's row parser strips one CR; strip the whole trailing run, bounded by CAPS_MAX_CR=16, matching lib/caps.sh.
SCENE: Three 4-cell parsers each strip CR; ops-reverify.sh removes only one.
INPUTS: scripts/ops-reverify.sh, scripts/lib/caps.sh, tests/test-scripts.sh
FORBIDDEN: scripts/lib/caps.sh
DONE: a \r\r\n ledger yields the same output as its LF twin (bash tests/test-scripts.sh, the '#139 item 1' block, 0 failed)
REACH: maintainers run ops-reverify.sh at release; the case invokes scripts/ops-reverify.sh directly

PACKET T2:
TASK: Add ops-backlog.sh to the install set
TEXT: Add ops-backlog.sh to the _OPS_TOOLS literal in scripts/ops-install-set.sh and bump the two tests that count the set from 6 to 7.
SCENE: scripts/ops-install-set.sh is the ONE declaration both writers source.
INPUTS: scripts/ops-install-set.sh, tests/test-scripts.sh
FORBIDDEN: everything else
DONE: grep -c ops-backlog scripts/ops-install-set.sh → 1; bash tests/test-scripts.sh → 0 failed
REACH: ops-init.sh sources ops-install-set.sh (grep -n install-set scripts/ops-init.sh)

PACKET T3:
TASK: Decide filename vs body sentinel ownership
TEXT: Decide whether sentinel ownership should move from the filename (pending/<sid>__<task>) to a body field; record the decision and the rejected option with reasons in DECISIONS.md.
SCENE: Six readers hand-copy the owner parser; ops-stop-hook.sh and statusline.sh must stay builtin-only; an unowned sentinel must fail closed.
INPUTS: scripts/ops-*.sh, scripts/lib/partition.sh, docs/maintainer/LANDMINES.md
FORBIDDEN: any script edit — this task is the decision only
DONE: a DECISIONS.md row of a record kind names the choice, the rejected option, and at least three measured reasons; python3 scripts/validate_plugin.py exits 0
REACH: DECISIONS.md is read by the Stop hook's deviation scan (grep -n DECISIONS scripts/ops-stop-hook.sh)

PACKET T4:
TASK: List CAPS_MAX_CR references
TEXT: Find every file that references CAPS_MAX_CR and report path:line for each.
SCENE: The bound is hand-copied across three parsers.
INPUTS: the whole repo
FORBIDDEN: any edit
DONE: a path:line list, matching grep -rn CAPS_MAX_CR output exactly
REACH: n/a — read-only; grep -rn CAPS_MAX_CR is the proof

PACKET T5:
TASK: Raise FLOOR_SHELL
TEXT: Raise FLOOR_SHELL in tests/floors.env from 1420 to 1432 to match the suite's passed+skipped count after this PR's 12 new cases.

INPUTS: tests/floors.env
FORBIDDEN: every other file
DONE: grep FLOOR_SHELL= tests/floors.env → FLOOR_SHELL=1432; bash scripts/gate-suite.sh shell → marker line with 1432
